name: Alirajpur–Chhota Udepur District road

tollInfo.note: District roads in India are not tolled.

significance: MDR 4708, Alirajpur–Chhota Udepur District road, crosses the border between Madhya Pradesh and Gujarat. A state road that runs through more than one state has no single owner — MP PWD and Gujarat R&B each maintain the stretch inside their own state, so which department to contact depends on where along the road you are.
